items.name: Combat chainsaw
items.description:
**Properties:**
- **Breaker:** Deals double damage to unattended objects and barriers.

- **Heavy:** Heavy frame (often Str 13+); Small creatures have disadvantage on attacks.
- **Two-Handed:** Requires two hands to attack.

items.name: Combat knife
items.description:
**Properties:**
- **Defensive:** Designed to pair with a shield of the listed degree or lighter; bonus action to shield-bash or gain +1 AC until next turn.
- **Dual-Wielding:** Balanced for two-weapon fighting.
- **Finesse:** Use Strength or Dexterity modifier for attack and damage rolls.
- **Thrown:** Can be thrown to the listed range using melee modifiers.
